We have metadata with paths to train.csv, test.csv, scaler.pkl. Need to evaluate model on test set and cross-validation.

We have tool evaluate_xgboost_model which takes model_path, test_data_path, target_column, detailed_analysis. It returns metrics including mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance, etc.

Also perform_cross_validation tool for training data.

We need to locate model file path: given earlier: /Users/n0w0f/.../trained_xgboost_model.pkl

Test data path from metadata: test_path.

Train data path: train_path.

We need to call evaluate_xgboost_model and perform_cross_validation.

Then combine results into JSON with keys test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results.

Save to results file in workspace: /Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/7/2_evaluate_model_performance_trial_2/model_evaluation_results.json

Let's call evaluate_xgboost_model.
